route: Hermes openai-codex delegate_task; no nested Codex CLI

independentRoles.planner: Single Blender atlas with a distinct National Assembly and complete central-agency directory; stale screenshots flagged and regenerated.
independentRoles.developer: Flagged whole-list aria-live, no-JS failure and mobile keyboard reachability; all three were fixed and retested.
independentRoles.marketer: Clarified actual links vs live tracking and made static-prototype copy explicit; customer brand direction remains CMO-owned.

finalIndependentReview.scope: Security, logic, static fallbacks, responsive screenshots and keyboard access; read-only reviewer.

policyFirstReview.planner: Historical policy cards first, agency catalogue nearby but no unverified causal edges; mobile does not need all ten above fold.
policyFirstReview.developer: Native policy and agency dialogs; preserve actual static anchor hrefs for JS failure; restore focus after saved card rerender.
policyFirstReview.marketer: Historical policy stage and source differentiated from current effect; no agency execution claim or CMO sign-off.
policyFirstReview.operator: Local regression, responsive and no-JS checks plus actual deployment and live browser/asset readback required.
policyFirstReview.redVerdict: PASS; no release-blocking defect found. Reviewer could not start own Chromium due to libnspr4.so; owner independently ran browser checks.
policyFirstReview.ownerDecision: Policy-first hero with 10 cases and agency catalogue in one stage; distinct on-page dialogs, official source links secondary; no fabricated policy-to-agency assignments.

limits: Agencies are listed conceptually, not pinned to verified addresses.
Brand preference and customer outcomes have not been independently validated.
